But as Israel took stock of the results, there was also a sense that the elections marked a longer-term shift in US politics that will make the job of any new Israeli leader far more difficult. title: 17-year-old US student discovers 3,300-year-old Egyptian amulet in Israel
summary: A 17-year-old US student, Shiloh Attoun, discovered a 3,300-year-old Egyptian-style scarab amulet during a school excursion to Tel Gezer National Park in Israel. The Late Bronze Age artefact features two cobra motifs representing an ancient Egyptian royal symbol. Archaeologists examined and dated the object before the Israel Antiquities Authority collected it for preservation. Attoun received a certificate of appreciation for reporting the discovery, which offers insights into ancient Egyptian cultural influence in the region.
